name: Metric Upkeep
description: Keeps a milestone's metrics able to show progress: decides by code from each metric record's fields whether it is fresh, stale, unmeasured or without a source, reads what it can read, and adds one intermediate metric the AI can move when the milestone's own metric moves only through a person.
purpose: Keep every milestone measurable by the AI's own work, so a turn asked to make progress never has the excuse of waiting on a person.
approach: Decide each metric's state from its record fields, read a stale or unmeasured metric through the reader its source names, and add one intermediate child metric, checked by independent views to track the parent's done test, when the parent moves only through a person.
out_of_scope: Choosing a request's metric (Metric Translation does that), writing the records (ESOI Application does that), checking a decision (Decision Check does that) and doing the work the metric counts (the consumer's work step does that).
milestones: 1. A metric's state is decided from its fields alone and an intermediate metric is added once, only after the check agrees it tracks the parent (metric-metric-upkeep).
measures_of_success: States match the record fields, a reading is recorded once, and an intermediate metric is added once and only when the check agrees.
inputs: The milestone (solution id, name, done-when, moved_by), its metric records, readers by source name, today's date and a model call.
outputs: One action per metric of the milestone: its state, the action taken (none, read, propose_source, define_intermediate), and the reading, the child metric or why not.
effects: Writes a reading or one child metric record through ESOI Application at the records location the consumer gave it.
usage_notes: Construct with the ESOI Application and Decision Check seats; call `upkeep(spec, metrics, readers, today, ask)`. A metric with no readable source gets a checked proposal for how it becomes readable, kept as knowledge on the milestone's record. Justification against siblings: Metric Translation turns a request into a target, ESOI Application edits records, Goal Completion judges a goal met; none keeps the metrics themselves measurable over time.
